description: Search IMDb titles, fetch titles by ID, browse charts, run advanced searches, export user reviews, or list every episode of a TV series.

countries.description: Filter by country-of-origin codes, e.g. US, GB, IN, JP. Multiple countries are combined with OR. Used in search and advanced modes.
countries.title: Countries of Origin

excludeSpoilers.description: Skip reviews flagged as containing spoilers.
excludeSpoilers.title: Exclude Spoiler Reviews

genres.description: Filter by genres, e.g. Drama, Thriller, Sci-Fi. Multiple genres are combined with AND. Used in search and advanced modes.
genres.title: Genres

imdbIds.description: IMDb title IDs (e.g. tt0111161) or title URLs. Used by byId, reviews and episodes modes. In episodes mode, pass TV series IDs.
imdbIds.sectionDescription: Used by byId, reviews and episodes modes. Accepts bare IDs (tt0111161), numbers (111161), or full IMDb title URLs.
imdbIds.title: IMDb Title IDs

languages.description: Filter by spoken-language codes, e.g. en, fr, hi, ta. Multiple languages are combined with OR. Used in search and advanced modes.
languages.title: Spoken Languages

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return across all requested IDs (1-1000). Each review or episode is one record. Results are paginated, so the upstream 50-reviews-per-request limit does not cap this.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Keep the daily test run small; increase this for real exports.
maxItems.title: Max Items

minRating.description: Only include titles with at least this IMDb rating (1-10).
minRating.title: Minimum IMDb Rating

minVotes.description: Only include titles with at least this many IMDb votes.
minVotes.title: Minimum Vote Count

mode.description: What to fetch from IMDb: title search, direct IDs, a chart, the popularity meter, a filtered search, user reviews, or TV episodes.
mode.title: Mode

reviewSortBy.description: How to order reviews in reviews mode.
reviewSortBy.title: Review Sort Order

reviewSortOrder.description: Ascending or descending order for the review sort.
reviewSortOrder.title: Review Sort Direction

runtimeMax.description: Only include titles at most this many minutes long. Used in search and advanced modes.
runtimeMax.title: Runtime (max minutes)

runtimeMin.description: Only include titles at least this many minutes long. Used in search and advanced modes.
runtimeMin.title: Runtime (min minutes)

searchQuery.description: Free-text title search, e.g. 'inception' or 'breaking bad'. Used in search mode.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Used by search mode. The query is matched against IMDb's full title catalog.
searchQuery.title: Search Query

sortBy.description: Sort field for search and advanced modes.
sortBy.title: Sort By

sortOrder.description: Sort direction for search and advanced modes.
sortOrder.title: Sort Direction

titleType.description: Restrict results to one content type. Used in search, popular and advanced modes.
titleType.sectionDescription: Filters apply to search, advanced, popular and chart modes where noted. Reviews and episodes modes use only the IDs list.
titleType.title: Title Type

topRatedChart.description: Which IMDb chart to fetch in topRated mode.
topRatedChart.sectionDescription: Used by topRated mode only. For the current most popular titles, use Popular Now mode.
topRatedChart.title: Chart

yearMax.description: Include only titles released on or before this year.
yearMax.title: Release Year (max)

yearMin.description: Include only titles released on or after this year.
yearMin.title: Release Year (min)

title: IMDb Scraper Input
